answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent must lock a deposit of jade tokens before it can offer services, and the deposit is forfeited if peers prove it misbehaved. Creating many fake identities then means funding each one, so a sybil swarm faces a real cost canyon between cheap talk and trusted participation. Newcomers start on a small island of low-trust tasks and earn wider access only through verified work, so one operator cannot cheaply clone a hundred reputable agents.
